fixture_notes.purpose: coverage-validation case: a small HTTP application whose class path and lazily-loaded archives span 12 independent jars across three groups (coverage_plan), used to measure recall and false-positive rates against an independently obtained ground truth
fixture_notes.package_selection: 12 well-known Maven Central artifacts with no interdependency across groups, chosen so each jar's use or non-use is a fact about this fixture's own code rather than a side effect of another jar's own dependencies. jackson-databind's own runtime dependency on jackson-core and jackson-annotations is kept intentional: the three are loaded together as one lazy group
fixture_notes.startup_vs_lazy_vs_unused: the startup group's jars are named directly on the JVM's -cp at launch, so the JVM opens each one's central directory before this program runs, independent of whether a class inside it is ever loaded — and this fixture also loads one class from each to leave nothing on the boundary. The lazy group's jars are never on the launch class path; a class from each is loaded, once fired, through a URLClassLoader this program builds only at that point, which is what first opens those files. The unused group's jars are copied into the image but are never named on any class loader's path at all, so they are neither opened nor read
fixture_notes.operational_processing: a background shell loop execs curl, git and openssl every five seconds once the container starts, independently of the firing signal, as this case's short-lived OS-package activity
fixture_notes.runtime_introspection: at startup, after the lazy loads, and again before exiting, the program invokes a small script that reads the new tail of the JVM's own -Xlog:class+load=info output and appends one JSON Lines record per class loaded from a jar file to /var/log/runtime-modules.jsonl — the ground-truth tool's own independent source, distinct from this harness's own event or sampling evidence
fixture_notes.coverage_plan_caveat: the three groups are the fixture's design intent (GT-A), not the measured ground truth
